intro: One glass of teh halia is about 130 kcal. Almost all of the calories come from condensed milk and evaporated milk.
diet: Yes, but count it as part of your daily calories. One glass a day is no problem. If you drink 2-3 glasses a day, the sugar calories add up fast. Go for kurang manis or teh O halia if you drink it often.
tips: Order 'teh halia kurang manis'. Most mamak will understand.
Switch to teh O halia kosong for your second glass.
Drink it with a meal, not as a separate afternoon snack.

swap.name: Teh O halia kosong
swap.why: You still get the warm ginger taste, with almost zero calories.

faq.q: Is teh halia good for bloating?
faq.a: Many people find teh halia comforting when they feel bloated. But it's not a treatment. See a doctor if the problem keeps coming back.

faq.q: Can I make teh halia at home?
faq.a: Yes. Boil sliced ginger, add a tea bag, then add a little evaporated milk to taste.
Yes, from the tea. A bit less than coffee, so avoid drinking it late at night if you're sensitive.
